```
### Key Improvements Made
1. **Removed Title Redundancy:** Replaced the double "Title" prompts with standard GitHub frontmatter `title: "[BUG / FEATURE / DOCS]: <Brief description>"`.
2. **Interactive Checkboxes:** Added type selectors (`- [ ]`) so contributors can categorize their submission instantly.
3. **Structured Context:** Included a dedicated block for logs and environment details (OS, Python version, ComptaRAG version), which are essential for reproducing bugs in RAG pipelines.
4. **Clean Markdown Layout:** Applied horizontal rules and clear headings to make scanning easy for project maintainers.

```
